source_evidence: It can also sell any of the securities in your account to cover any shortfall, without informing you in advance.
question: If securities bought on margin decline in value and leave a shortfall, what actions may the brokerage firm take?
answer: The firm may require you to deposit cash or securities immediately. It may also sell securities in your account to cover the shortfall without informing you in advance; the firm decides which securities to sell.
